devices.description: List of block devices to scan, each with optional override parameters. Must be root-owned block devices (e.g., /dev/sda).

devices[].device_path.description: Absolute path to the block device (e.g., /dev/sda1). Required per entry.

devices[].scan_mode.description: Scan mode: 'seq' (sequential) or 'random'. Defaults to sequential.

devices[].block_size.description: Block size in bytes for scanning; must be a multiple of the sector size (typically 512). Default is 1 MiB.

devices[].fix.description: If true, attempt to fix areas nearing failure. Only safe on unmounted devices.

verbose.description: Verbosity level: 0 (silent), 1 (normal), 2 (more), 3 (most). Each level adds a -v flag.

output_file.description: Path to JSON output file for summary and exceptional events. If empty, output goes to stdout.

raw_log_file.description: Path to JSON file for raw scan log. If empty, raw log is not written.
